caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular area bordered by decorative patterns along the top and left edges. Along the top, there is a horizontal border composed of large dark green leaves spaced evenly with smaller pink leaves in between, above a stripe of diagonal green and pink lines. The left edge has a vertical border featuring a repeated circular motif in green. Within the rectangle, there are three distinct botanical or floral designs: the largest at the bottom left shows a curved stem with multiple small pink flowers and green leaves; near the center top, another cluster of green leaves and pink petals is arranged in a symmetrical pattern; to the right, there is a smaller rose-like plant with curved stems, green leaves, and pink buds. The drawing is made with watercolor or ink, using primarily green and pink colors on a light cream background. There is a faint patch of yellowish discoloration at the lower left corner outside the bordered area.
title: Stencilled Wall
